name: agent-harness
description: Project-agnostic Claude Code harness: guards, conventions and profiles

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: Guard hooks, PR skill, verifiers, and harnessctl — the declarative installer for permissions, CLAUDE.md and rules

plugins.name: harness-dev
plugins.description: Product and service development profile: core plus Superpowers and PR review conventions

plugins.name: harness-research
plugins.description: Research profile: core plus the five-document note discipline and a reproducibility checklist

plugins.name: harness-python
plugins.description: Core plus the Pyright language server. Requires pyright-langserver on PATH — run harnessctl doctor

plugins.name: harness-typescript
plugins.description: Core plus the TypeScript/JavaScript language server. Requires the server on PATH — run harnessctl doctor

plugins.name: harness-slides
plugins.description: Results-to-deck narrative with a traceability check. Rendering is delegated to slides-grab (npm)

plugins.name: harness-frontend
plugins.description: Core plus ui-ux-pro-max, a UI/UX design reference. Depends on a third-party marketplace — register it before installing
